python3 -c "import json,time,urllib.request as u
def call(m,url,body=None):
    r=u.Request(url,method=m,data=None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode(),headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
    try: return json.load(u.urlopen(r,timeout=60))
    except u.HTTPError as e: return {'http_error':e.code}
Q='http://127.0.0.1:26333'
docs=['passage: restic restore latest --target DIR restores the newest backup snapshot into DIR','passage: Prometheus scrapes metrics from HTTP targets at a fixed interval','passage: Loki indexes log streams by label and stores chunks on the filesystem']
q='query: how do I recover files from my latest backup?'
v=[x['embedding'] for x in sorted(call('POST','http://127.0.0.1:18231/v1/embeddings',{'model':'nvidia/Nemotron-3-Embed-1B-BF16','input':[q]+docs})['data'],key=lambda x:x['index'])]
n0=len(call('GET',Q+'/collections')['result']['collections'])
name='nsr_receipt_probe_%d'%int(time.time())
c=call('PUT',Q+'/collections/'+name,{'vectors':{'size':len(v[0]),'distance':'Cosine'}})
p=call('PUT',Q+'/collections/'+name+'/points?wait=true',{'points':[{'id':i+1,'vector':v[i+1],'payload':{'doc':i}} for i in range(len(docs))]})
s=call('POST',Q+'/collections/'+name+'/points/search',{'vector':v[0],'limit':3,'with_payload':True})
hits=[(h['payload']['doc'],round(h['score'],4)) for h in s.get('result',[])]
d=call('DELETE',Q+'/collections/'+name);g=call('GET',Q+'/collections/'+name);n1=len(call('GET',Q+'/collections')['result']['collections'])
print('dims',len(v[0]),'| create',c.get('result'),'| upsert',p.get('result',{}).get('status'),'| hits (doc, score)',hits,'| delete',d.get('result'),'| get after delete http',g.get('http_error'),'| collections before/after',n0,n1)
raise SystemExit(0 if c.get('result') is True and hits and hits[0][0]==0 and d.get('result') is True and g.get('http_error')==404 and n0==n1 else 1)"
